name: § 3, indent 8 – 78
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: – the successful finalisation of the screening process for North Macedonia at the end of 2023; urges the government of North Macedonia to achieve tangible results in fulfilling its obligation under the EU negotiating framework and the conclusions of the European Council meeting of 18 July 2022, including relevant constitutional changes, in line with the country’s commitments;
